description: Fixed vector for secure input (BACKEND 8.7). Seal: X25519(ephemeralPrivateKey, sandboxPublicKey) -> HKDF-SHA256(salt=UTF-8 requestId, info="juno-secure-input-v1", 32 bytes) -> AES-256-GCM(nonce, AAD="<requestId>|<fieldId>|<ref>"). ciphertext = encrypted bytes followed by the 16-byte tag. All binary values are base64.
